Different choices of supplied and predicted tokens express perception, geometry, language, and imagination within a single transformer.(B)Compositional unification.Streams of thought combine model capabilities.(C)Optimization unification.Because intermediate representations are predictions of the same model, choosing which representations to generate and use becomes a learnable action.

header: 2  A Unified Model with Adaptive Streams of Thought

images.caption:
Figure 2:Architecture, training recipe, and prompting interface.(A)Ψ\Psi-0.6 is a unified model across diverse modalities. Pretraining, mid-training, and post-training sample different sequence families; hollow tokens denote stochastically included sequence elements.
Generic prompting interface: prompts specify the available information and requested inference pathway.Ψ\Psi-0.6 is interactive: it can generate a view based on a user-specified camera pose, then use that generated view as context for subsequent reasoning.(B)Fine-grained control: each patch is represented by a pointer token and content tokens. Pointers specify modality and spatial and temporal locations, enabling targeted conditioning and scene edits. Probabilistic prediction:Ψ\Psi-0.6 represents a distribution over compatible continuations, allowing the same prompt to yield alternative predictions through sampling.

Figure 5:Counterfactual imagination of object motion.(A)Answering a counterfactual question requires imagining the outcome of a hypothetical motion. A person, likeΨ\Psi-0.6, imagines the box sliding in front of the cup and answers correctly, whereas a VLM that reasons only in text does not.(B)A FlowBench-Real question on real robot data.Ψ\Psi-0.6 generalizes to FlowBench-Real after training on FlowBench-Sim (Tab.3).(C)Stream of Thought on FlowBench-Sim:Ψ\Psi-0.6 predicts the optical flow of the instructed motion, decoding high-P⁡(motion)P(\text{motion})patches first (pMotion) with text-enhanced CFG (2×2\timesimage-and-text minus1×1\timesimage-only logits), then the future frame, and reasons to its answer. Bottom: FlowBench question types.

header: 6  Optimization Unification: RL for Adaptive Streams of Thought

images.caption: Figure 6:Learning adaptive stream-of-thought reasoning.(A)Given a video and question,Ψ\Psi-0.6 functions as both a policy – emitting a notation naming the stream of thought to use – and as a VLM, answering with those streams in context.(B)The GRPO RL loop: collect notations with the current policy, score each by probability of ground-truth answer relative to RGB-only, and train on the beneficial notations.(C)The learnedΨ\Psi-0.6 policy improves video question-answering accuracy, with gains generalizing to unseen benchmarks.(D)These accuracy gains are a result of loss reductions on the ground truth.
